title: AVX Action
description: A human-initiated action taken in response to a Finding. Dispatched via the executor layer. Spec source: specs/2026-09-18-avx-tier2-ios-cards-and-actions/spec.md § 'Cross-surface Action data model — canonical' including Contract Addenda D4, D5.

created_by.description: Identity of the actor who created the action. Format: owner-{id} | dealer-{id} | fleet-manager-{id}

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of action creation.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent state change on this Action (set on create and on every status transition). Callers surface this as staleness context per parent PRD § M5. Contract Addendum C2 (review Cycle 1).

target_system.description: Executor target. One executor class per target system.

target_ref.description: Downstream system reference ID, populated by the executor after successful dispatch (e.g. DMS-RO-9999 for dms, message-id for ios-owner). Optional until executed.

status.description: Action lifecycle state. Addenda D4/D5: 'dismissed' — owner tapped Dismiss (terminal, distinct from 'cancelled' and 'declined'); 'failed' — executor exhausted retries on transient downstream failure (terminal, distinct from 'declined' which is a terminal 4xx refusal).

action_kind.description: Action type. Extensible; enum is test-pinned per executor. These are the Spec 1a values.

parameters.description: Executor-specific parameters. Shape varies per target_system.

evidence.description: COPY of the originating Finding's evidence at approval time. Immutable — later Finding re-runs do NOT mutate this copy.

audit_trail.description: Ordered log of state transitions. Addendum D5: transitions to 'declined' or 'failed' must carry failure_kind (and retry_count for 'failed').

source.description: System that produced this evidence entry.

source_ref.description: Opaque reference to the source record.

value.description: The evidence value. Any JSON-serialisable type.

computed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this evidence was collected.

provenance.description: Data provenance. 'mocked' required by Spec 1b Agent 3 mocked partner seams (parent PRD § M14). Must be an accepted enum value even in Spec 1a.

vin.description: Optional per-VIN attribution, copied from the originating Finding's evidence entries (Addendum D1).

allOf.$comment: Addendum D5: 'declined' means the downstream target REFUSED the work (terminal 4xx). It must carry failure_kind=target_refused and must NOT borrow a transient failure_kind — otherwise 'dealer said no' and 'we could not reach the dealer' become indistinguishable, which is the entire distinction D5 exists to create.

Addendum D5: 'failed' means the executor exhausted its retry budget against a transient failure (5xx / network / timeout). failure_kind is constrained to the transient kinds, and retry_count is required so the audit trail records how many attempts were spent before escalation fired.

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the transition.

by.description: Identity of the actor who triggered the transition.

note.description: Optional free-text note for the transition.

failure_kind.description: Required when to_status is 'declined' (kind=target_refused) or 'failed' (kind=executor_exhausted_retries | executor_terminal_error). Addendum D5.

retry_count.description: Number of retry attempts before the terminal 'failed' status. Populated on the transition into 'failed'. Addendum D5.
